ops.body: Please apply the approved Speculate Across Gates rule to phase 2b: the two-host acceptance test authoring is independent of final dependency SHAs now that interfaces/contracts exist. Start it in its own isolated cc-sync worktree from the current integration commit, explicitly speculative until p2a/final deps land, rather than leaving all of E2E queued behind merges. Its commits can merge into phase2b and be re-pinned/run after the final versions exist. Keep current implementation worktrees untouched and do not count speculative runs as final acceptance.
